description: The fastest Direct2D-powered image viewer for Windows. Supports multi-threaded JXL/AVIF decoding, GPU acceleration, RAW formats, and a borderless geek UI.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path "$persist_dir")) { New-Item "$persist_dir" -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }; foreach ($f in 'QuickView.ini', 'ai_actions.json') { if (Test-Path "$persist_dir\$f" -PathType Leaf) { Copy-Item "$persist_dir\$f" "$dir\$f" -Force } }
post_install: if (!(Test-Path "$persist_dir")) { New-Item "$persist_dir" -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }; foreach ($f in 'QuickView.ini', 'ai_actions.json') { if (Test-Path "$dir\$f" -PathType Leaf) { Copy-Item "$dir\$f" "$persist_dir\$f" -Force } }

uninstaller.script: if (!(Test-Path "$persist_dir")) { New-Item "$persist_dir" -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }; foreach ($f in 'QuickView.ini', 'ai_actions.json') { if (Test-Path "$dir\$f" -PathType Leaf) { Copy-Item "$dir\$f" "$persist_dir\$f" -Force } }
